kashika: तवैप्रत्ययान्तस्यान्तश्चशब्दादादिश्च युगपदुदात्तौ भवतः। कर्त॒वै। हर्त॒वै। प्रत्ययाद्युदात्तत्वापवादः। युगपद्ग्रहणं पर्यायनिवृत्त्यर्थम्। एकवर्जमिति वचनाद्यौगपद्यं न स्यात्॥
kashikaEnglish: Certain pratyayas in Vedas have special accents based on context.
englishFull:
तवैकारयोश्च — The infinitive in तवै has acute on both the first and last syllables simultaneously.

**Examples:**
कर्तवै, हर्तवै

This overrides @ref[3.1.3] (which would accent त) and also overrules @ref[6.1.158] (single accent per word). The infinitive तवै is exceptional in having two accents.
